test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: FAP is related to PAF in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JFM is related to MFJ. To which of the following is NKT related following the same logic?
solution:
**Logic: Rearrangement of the alphabet.**

FAP is related to PAF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ac993bdd71d2a001d2564646146d3eadad75fe4c1b3a96eb3706d6dcacd911b.png] 

JFM is related to MFJ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6fa361d59877d24628b60202f04b1bd9beb98a82f4aad0c1cc116d4864c9305.png] 

Similarly, 'NKT' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28fb615edb8141c7213f1a936c766c94c3740600407ca6f4ce253a9da86da25d.png] 

Here, 'NKT' is related to **'TKN'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
